---lvl 7 script---

local isPlayingDemo = false
local countFail = 0
local isSkip = true
local hasViewedStory = global.getBool("lvl8_b1")

if not hasViewedStory or not game.isRestart() then
	repeat
		if hasViewedStory then dialog.setSkipEnabled(true) end
	
		game.setUserInputEnabled(false)
		role.setIdleActionEnabled(false)
		script.delay(1)
		sound.play("41-1")
		if dialog.showMinTime("Level8-1", faceJingya,0) ==1 then break end
		camera.setFollowRoleMode(false)
		camera.gotoPosition(1040,912)
		script.delay(0.6)
		camera.gotoPosition(1015,1045)
		script.delay(0.6)
		camera.gotoPosition(926,765)
		sound.play("54-1")
		if dialog.show("Level8-2", faceDeyi) ==1 then break end
		if dialog.showMinTime("Level8-3", faceZhoumei,0) ==1 then break end
		camera.gotoRole()
		sound.play("58-1")
		if dialog.show("Level8-4", faceRenzhen) ==1 then break end
		camera.setFollowRoleMode(true)
		
		--set story viewed flag
        global.setBool("lvl8_b1")

		game.restartTiming()
		game.setUserInputEnabled(true)
		role.setIdleActionEnabled(true)
		isPlayingDemo = false
		isSkip = false
		
	
	until true
end



onRoleReachedMoon = function() 
    game.pauseLogic()
	sound.play("54-1")
    dialog.show("Level8-5", faceDeyi)
    game.success()
end

if isSkip then
	camera.gotoRole()
	camera.setFollowRoleMode(true)
	dialog.setSkipEnabled(false)
	game.resumeLogic()
	game.showTutorialDiagram(0)
	game.setUserInputEnabled(true)
	role.setIdleActionEnabled(true)
	game.restartTiming()
end
